title: crataegus monogyna f. alba-plena
intro: Crataegus monogyna f. alba-plena, commonly known as White Hawthorn, is a variety of the hawthorn plant that is characterized by its dense, white flowers and deciduous leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of White Hawthorn include cardiotonic and vasodilatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of White Hawthorn include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
